title: Prechecked order insertion in 0x26 Chain
mechanism: Recognize same-side, non-crossing, append-compatible PlaceOrder batches. Commit policy admissions in body order, append by market, then restore outcome and event order using original indices.
eligibility: At least two body items, all PlaceOrder intents.
Valid market and request; no active or within-batch duplicate client-order key.
Limit order that may post, with no crossing or immediate-execution requirement.
Each candidate follows the existing same-side tail and prior candidate under price-time priority.
Cumulative risk checks, runtime gates, and ordered policy admission succeed.

append_proposition.scope: Matching book and per-order outcomes for a successful eligible group at one fixed timestamp, after expiry handling.
assumptions: The resting-batch validator accepts the group.
append_proposition.argument: Induct on candidates. Each candidate follows the current tail under the same price-time comparator. Non-crossing same-side inserts leave the opposite book unchanged. Append and sequential insertion allocate the same sequences and produce no-fill resting outcomes.

remaining_copies: May payload filter: one full policy-store and mandate-map clone up front, then one of each per candidate that reaches simulation; also accumulated simulated book and collateral maps
Affected-market book simulations for initial margin and leverage
copy_scope.claim: The branch bypasses four commit-stage overlay allocations. Earlier per-candidate full-store copies remain. This does not quantify whole-path copy savings or a May deployment speedup.

implementation_excerpts.code:
pub(super) fn ensure_resting_order_batch_preserves_mandate_max_leverage(
    policy_store: &PolicyStore,
    mandates: &BTreeMap<MandateId, Mandate>,
    order_books: &BTreeMap<u64, SingleMarketBook>,
    isolated_collateral: &BTreeMap<(u64, u64), i128>,
    markets: &BTreeMap<u64, PerpetualMarket>,
    market_marks: &BTreeMap<u64, OraclePrice>,
    positions: &BTreeMap<(u64, u64), PositionLedger>,
    orders: &[OrderRequest],
    signed_intents: &[&SignedIntent],
    timestamp_ms: u64,
) -> Result<(), NodeError> {
    debug_assert_eq!(orders.len(), signed_intents.len());
    let mut simulated_order_books = BTreeMap::new();
    for (order, signed_intent) in orders.iter().zip(signed_intents.iter()) {
        simulation_order_book_for_market(&mut simulated_order_books, order_books, order.market_id);
        ensure_order_preserves_mandate_max_leverage(
            policy_store,
            mandates,
            &simulated_order_books,
            isolated_collateral,
            markets,
            market_marks,
            positions,
            signed_intent,
            order,
            None,
            timestamp_ms,
        )?;
        simulated_order_books
            .entry(order.market_id)
            .or_insert_with(|| SingleMarketBook::new(order.market_id))
            .submit(*order, timestamp_ms)
            .map_err(NodeError::Order)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn resting_order_cmp(left: &RestingOrder, right: &RestingOrder) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
    match (left.side, right.side) {
        (OrderSide::Bid, OrderSide::Ask) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
        (OrderSide::Ask, OrderSide::Bid) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
        (OrderSide::Bid, OrderSide::Bid) => right
            .price_ticks
            .cmp(&left.price_ticks)
            .then_with(|| left.sequence.cmp(&right.sequence)),
        (OrderSide::Ask, OrderSide::Ask) => left
            .price_ticks
            .cmp(&right.price_ticks)
            .then_with(|| left.sequence.cmp(&right.sequence)),
    }
}
